# dsh-mcp-autoload
Auto-discover project-level MCP servers for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

Place a `.agents/mcp.json` at your project root (the nearest ancestor with a
`.git` marker). Every D

SH agent session whose working directory is inside that
project automatically mounts the declared se

rvers; connections close when the
session ends. Servers from other projects never leak in.
English | 中文
The panel above is the session MCP inventory. `time` comes from the project's `.agents/mcp.json` (ma
rked 项目级 / project level); `codegraph` comes from the profile (用户级 / user level).

Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0` and Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. `dsh plugin`
forwards its argume
nts to pnpm inside the profile directory.

ndles` for you. Restart `dsh web` afterwards — the host

e browser (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R).

## Field reference
| Field | Transport | Notes |
| `command` | stdio | Executable: a bare name resolved from `PATH` (`npx`, `uvx`) or an absolute pat

h. Required for stdio |
| `args` | stdio | Optional string array, passed through without shell inter

polation |
| `env` | stdio | Optional string map merged over the scrubbed child environment; explici

t entries survive the scrub |
| `url` | Streamable HTTP | Absolute `http(s)://` URL. Required for HT

TP |
| `headers` | Streamable HTTP | Optional string map of extra request headers |
| `type` | — | O

ptional; accepted values are `stdio` and `http`. `sse` is rejected with a log line |
| `disabled` /
`enabled` | — | Optional; `disabled: true` or `enabled: false` skips the entry silently (both Claude
Code and Codex spellings). The popover removes both fields to enable, or writes `disabled: true` to
Codex spellings). The popover removes both fields to enable, or writes `disabled: true` to disable |

**Transport selection:** an entry with `url` mounts over Streamable HTTP;
otherwise `command` mounts

a stdio child process whose working directory is
the session's cwd. An entry with neither is skippe
d with an error log.

**Server names.** A name matching `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}` passes through
unchanged (`postgres_local`,

`experimental_server` stay as-is). Any other name — Chinese
characters, spaces, over-long — is norma

lized to a deterministic slug (the
same algorithm the DSH ACP bridge uses), e.g. `我的服务器` → `server_<

o a deterministic slug (the
same algorithm the DSH ACP bridge uses), e.g. `我的服务器` → `server_<hash>`.

**Tool names.** Each server's tools register for that session as
`mcp__<serverName>__<rawToolName>`,
e.g. `mcp__playwright__browser_navigate`.
## Behavior

- **Per-session scope.** Each server mounts inside the agent's Cordis scope:
tools apply to that ses

sion only, and connections close when the agent is
disposed. Two sessions in different projects can

use the same server name
independently.
- **Startup.** Mounting runs in the **background** after the

session is
created: a new session returns immediately instead of waiting for the MCP
handshake and

tool discovery (a single connection may take up to its own
request timeout). Opening the popover lis

ts **every server declared in the
manifest right away** (disabled entries included), and each server

connects
and updates **its own row** independently: once connected, that row shows the
tools it reg

istered and their count, while a failing server shows its error on
that row only. The dock trigger r

eports progress as "connected n/N" (n =
enabled servers mounted, N = enabled servers). While discove

ry is in flight,
opening the popover keeps re-querying until the host reports it settled
(bounded re

tries — a failed or hanging mount never polls forever), and
Refresh re-checks on demand. Project too

ls can therefore be missing from the
first turns until the mount completes. Servers connect in paral

lel; one slow
or broken server never blocks the others (`failOnStartupError` stays false). A
server

that fails to connect is skipped with an error log and the rest keep
working.
- **In-session managem

ent.** The popover can enable/disable project MCP servers;
a click applies immediately — no browser

confirmation dialog in either
direction (the row's own state and the notice below are the feedback).

The manifest is locked, backed up (only the five
newest backups are kept) and replaced atomically;

a symlinked manifest is
followed so the link itself survives. Disabling unloads its tools at once. I

f
re-enabling cannot mount, the manifest is rolled back to its previous state and
the failure is rep

orted — the file never claims a state the session could not
actually mount.
- **User-level MCPs.** P
rofile-configured entries are listed but cannot be toggled here; only project manifest entries are w

ritable.
- **No external hot reload.** The manifest is read once per session start (including resume

). Manual edits require a new session to apply.

## Security

`.agents/mcp.json` entries are **executed** on session start. A cloned
repository containing this fi

le gets to run arbitrary `command` lines on your
machine — the same trust level as an npm postinstal

l script. Only add this
file to projects you trust, and review it when cloning others'.
## Compatibility

Peer packages (`@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`,
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`) are

provided by the DSH installation; the
bundle declares them only for version checks. Requires DSH >=

bundle declares them only for version checks. Requires DSH >= 0.2.1-0 < 0.3.0.
